## Summary

Full-Stack Software Engineer who ships products to production and keeps them running.
Four production systems built, deployed and operated on self-managed VPS infrastructure:
a university services platform officially adopted by Al Sham Private University's housing
department, a marketplace founded from scratch, a legal foundation's bilingual public site,
and a classifieds platform in pre-launch. Flutter mobile development, Laravel REST backends,
Linux/Nginx operations with monitoring and automated backups, and AI automation with n8n.

Freelance full-stack software engineer since January 2024. Flutter developer and product
contributor at Lumi Coin Syria since September 2025.

## Production systems

### WeinKorsi — https://www.wein-korsi.com/
Founder & Full-Stack Engineer. Educational marketplace connecting students, training
institutes and course providers. In production since launch: 12 training institutes
onboarded, 100+ registered users. Role-based access for students, institutes and
administrators; OTP authentication, authorization middleware, rate limiting, and Arabic
RTL course discovery and reservation flows.
Stack: React (Vite), Laravel 12, Flutter, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2, VPS (Nginx).

### EduPal — https://edu-pal.tech/
Sole Full-Stack Engineer. Adopted by Al Sham Private University as the operational system
for its student housing department, serving 100+ students plus housing staff and managers.
Mobile app, web dashboard and backend delivered single-handedly. Digitizes room assignments,
contracts, deposits, room inventory and payment tracking, with a dual-wallet finance system
and a real-time ledger.
Stack: Flutter, GetX, Clean Architecture, PostgreSQL, JWT, VPS (Nginx).

### Foundation for the Support & Protection of Citizens Abroad — https://syru-legal.up.railway.app/ar
Backend Developer & Maintainer. Public platform of a non-profit legal advisory foundation
serving Russian nationals in Syria. Bilingual Arabic/Russian interface with full RTL and
Cyrillic support, and a consultation request workflow routed to the legal team. Bot and
abuse protection via Cloudflare Turnstile, honeypot fields and strict security headers.
Built in one month, maintained in production since, ~500 monthly visitors.
Stack: Laravel 11, Cloudflare Turnstile, Brevo API, hosted on Railway.

### OboSyria — https://obosyria.com/
Sole Engineer. Moderated classifieds platform for real estate and vehicle listings, where
every listing is reviewed and approved before publication. Laravel REST API serving a React
single-page application from the same origin, delivered as an installable PWA with a service
worker. Passwordless WhatsApp OTP login, administrator MFA, and rate limiting at both the
application and Nginx layers. Deployed and operating in pre-launch — not yet publicly launched.
Stack: Laravel, React (Vite), PWA / Service Workers, Cloudflare R2, WhatsApp OTP (Wasender),
Resend, VPS (Nginx).

## Other projects

- **Lumi Rewards** — Flutter Developer & Product Contributor. B2B loyalty product for the
  Syrian market built in Flutter with GetX and Clean Architecture: vendor-facing menus,
  offers and rewards, a merchant partner directory, and CI/CD-gated releases.
- **UniVerse** — Graduation project. Smart campus app with a hybrid AI scheduler (n8n +
  Gemini) generating personalised academic schedules from GPA and prerequisite rules, a RAG
  AI chatbot answering student queries in real time, and live bus tracking over WebSockets
  on OpenStreetMap. Flutter, GetX, Clean Architecture, Socket.IO, Firebase FCM.
- **Nibrass Hub** — Personal project. Clean Architecture Flutter build with an assistant
  answering housing and transport questions. Not a production system.
  Flutter, GetX, Clean Architecture, n8n, Gemini, JWT.
- **Expen Scope (EXS)** — Personal project. Dual-personality finance assistant for business
  and individual flows, with n8n + Gemini automation.
- **SSSD Mobile App** — Flutter Developer. Mobile service-request and news platform for the
  Syrian Society for Social Development.
- **Smart Telegram Bot / WhatsApp Automation Bot** — Automation Engineer. n8n workflows
  routing Telegram support queries into structured Google Sheets logs; a Node.js WhatsApp
  service handling repeatable customer responses.
